title: Promote a harness artifact
summary: Evaluates one staged harness artifact against exact usage and evidence before changing discoverability or host invocation behavior.

intent.goal: Produce one evidence-bound promotion or refusal without converting testimony, popularity, or a batch request into authority.
useWhen: A staged artifact is proposed for broader discoverability or host invocation.
excludeWhen: The artifact is still being authored, reviewed for initial adoption, retired, or changed in content.

procedure.outcome: Bind the decision to one exact artifact and current fingerprint.
requirements: Bind every input and observation to one exact governed source or explicit operator decision.
stopConditions: Stop when required evidence, authority, or an exact prerequisite is unavailable.

procedure.outcome: Inspect applicable usage, gotchas, evaluations, and host-effect facts rather than relying on testimony.
requirements: Bind every input and observation to one exact governed source or explicit operator decision.
stopConditions: Stop when required evidence, authority, or an exact prerequisite is unavailable.

procedure.outcome: Separate discoverability from invocation and prohibit automatic invocation for side-effecting behavior.
requirements: Bind every input and observation to one exact governed source or explicit operator decision.
stopConditions: Stop when required evidence, authority, or an exact prerequisite is unavailable.

procedure.outcome: Prepare a promotion or refusal with evidence, limitations, and exact proposed metadata changes.
requirements: Bind every input and observation to one exact governed source or explicit operator decision.
stopConditions: Stop when required evidence, authority, or an exact prerequisite is unavailable.

procedure.outcome: Apply only an explicitly confirmed scope and verify the resulting artifact and host projection remain valid.
requirements: Bind every input and observation to one exact governed source or explicit operator decision.
stopConditions: Stop when required evidence, authority, or an exact prerequisite is unavailable.

safeguards: Never transfer evidence between artifacts or promote a batch as one decision.
Never grant automatic invocation to side-effecting behavior.
Never treat the requester claim or a demo deadline as usage evidence.
limitations: This definition declares workflow outcomes and boundaries; it does not itself grant execution, provider, publication, merge, or host-realization authority.
Behavior evidence and effects remain scoped to exact governed development requests and current workflow fingerprints.
